violations.type: Missing semantic action (excludeSemantics removes tap action)
violations.affected_code:
Semantics(
      button: true,
      expanded: expanded,
      label: text,
      excludeSemantics: true,
      child: ... InkWell(onTap: onTap, ...)
violations.explanation: excludeSemantics: true drops the descendant semantics, including the tap action contributed by InkWell. The Semantics node declares button: true but provides no onTap handler. Assistive technologies may announce a button that cannot be activated via screen reader double-tap or switch access.

violations.type: Fixed height may clip text on large font scaling
violations.explanation: The container has a fixed height of 48. When users increase the system text scale, the 14pt text may overflow or be clipped, harming readability.
